subject: general
question: What is the value of a² + 4b² + 9c² - 4ab + 12bc - 6ca?
solution:
Given:

a2 + 4b2 + 9c2 - 4ab + 12bc - 6ca

Formula used:

(a + b + c)² = a² + b² + c² + 2(ab + bc + ca)

Calculations:

⇒ a2 + 4b2 + 9c2 - 4ab + 12bc - 6ca 

⇒ (a)² + (-2b)² +(-3c)² +2{ a(-2b) + (-2b)(-3c) + a(-3c) }

⇒ (a - 2b - 3c)2

∴ the required value is (a - 2b - 3c)².
